steps: Loaded T35F400 directly with openpyxl, independently of extract_t35_package.py's ZIP/XML implementation.
Enumerated A-H with worksheet row numbers; normalized None to an empty string and other values with str().
Selected rows whose H cell fully matches [A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{1,2}; mapped A-H to the eight documented source columns.
Compared all 400 ordered records and source_row values to csv.DictReader output; checked every board_net is blank.
Independently recomputed unique balls, GPIO-name, DDR-annotation, DDIO-Yes, LVDS-annotation and per-bank counts and compared them with the report.
Recomputed the source workbook SHA256 and compared it with the report. Recorded current CSV and report SHA256 values without regenerating either artifact.

limitations: These are raw manufacturer source counts. Annotations overlap and must not be added together or treated as an available-pin budget.
Blank board_net fields mean this inventory contains no board net assignments; they are not a claim about a completed PCB.
This comparison does not verify clocks, bank voltages, DDR lane assignments, electrical compatibility, Efinity acceptance, synthesis, placement, routing, timing closure or physical hardware.
